villagemaster/31336.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: Heed the warning that our ancestors whisper in your ears! See the omens that are appear before your eyes! Feel the danger at your very doorstep! The eternal will soon be upon us! Can you feel the impending calamity? What is it that we must do during these times? If you remain …

links.text: Listen to information about second class transfer.

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/0-01.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: Welcome, young Overlord! Have you heard of the recent goings-on among the six Orc tribes?

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/0-04.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: All I could find out from the Dudamara was where Flame Successor Akkan may be headed! Please go after him, my Overlord! I've heard that a Ketra Orc Messenger of the Betrayer Lesser Orcs has met with him. You must find Akkan!

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/0-06.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: Thank you, Overlord! Although you couldn't find Atlus of the Gandi tribe, thanks to you, Flame Successor Akkan has returned to us! Let me tell you one more thing. Your success means that you've completed the Pilgrimage of the King! No one's done that since ancient times!

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/0-09.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: According to the Dudamara, you have what it takes to rule a tribe. Act accordingly!

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/0-010.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: Although you have what it takes to be a king, you should go and get stronger. Authority without power is meaningless! (Only a character of level 76 may transfer class. Don't abandon the quest before class transfer is complete!)
when: cond 20; NOT level >= 76; !((npcId == 31336) && st.isCompleted()); player.getClassId().getId() == getPrevClass(player)

Q00078_SagaOfTheDoomcryer/0-01.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: Beware the coming eternal winter! Beware, oh child of fire! You who speak with dead souls... Certainly you've heard of it from them! Have you laid in provisions for an eternity?

Q00078_SagaOfTheDoomcryer/0-04.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: The Dudamara totem spirit can tell you where Tarkai is! Tejakar Oroka!

Q00078_SagaOfTheDoomcryer/0-06.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: Is this the one he requested? The flame that we need to sustain us through the endless winter! Along with countless dead souls... I can't just stand by and do nothing! I'll analyze the reports from you seers of the battlefield and manage the deployment of dead souls. It won't …

links.text: "Maybe I can do it with Sharuhi's help."

Q00078_SagaOfTheDoomcryer/0-09.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: If you can commune with even one dead soul, you will transcend the power of a Warcryer! Now your power will exceed that of the one who can communicate with 99 dead souls! You will communicate with all dead souls at once, and your cries will ring out every place you go! You'll …

Q00078_SagaOfTheDoomcryer/0-010.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: With the eternal winter bearing down upon us, you shall lead based upon what you learn from the dead souls. (Only a character at level 76 or above may transfer class. Be careful. You cannot change occupation if you stop Quest!)
when: cond 20; NOT level >= 76; !((npcId == 31336) && st.isCompleted()); player.getClassId().getId() == getPrevClass(player)

Q00241_PossessorOfAPreciousSoul1/31336-0.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: Welcome. Are you the one Kassandra was talking about? She's the girl with the nightmares. To prepare medicine for her I need a very rare herb. Will you help me save her?

Grand Seer Rahorakti: Should the one who holds the Star of Destiny really be doing favors for someone else? Go to the Cemetry and get five units of Crimson Moss by killing Taik Orc Supply Leader and cutting them open.
Grand Seer Rahorakti: Now I can make a drug to control evil dream spirits and restore her vitality! It won't take long.
Grand Seer Rahorakti: Take the medicine that I, Rahorakti, made you, to the dreaming girl of flame, Kassandra.

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/0-02.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: Flame Lord Kakai has amazing powers, but even they aren't enough alone! I have great hopes for you, but you're not ready yet. (This quest may only be undertaken by an Overlord of level 76 or above.)

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/0-03.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: Flame Lord Kakai has truly amazing power! Without him we would never survive the endless winter! But alas, he has no successor. If he dies now, who will save us? Overlords are quite rare in these parts. Among them, those worthy of becoming king are even fewer! I've lost touch …

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/0-05.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: In the beginning, the six Orc tribes were equal. Over time, the Hestuis rose to prominence, and the other tribes began following them. The Atubas were in charge of raising Warriors, the Dudamaras were in charge of Khavatari and the Hestui tribe performed all the rituals for th…

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/0-07.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: According to historical documents, whoever completes the Pilgrimage of the King obtains the right to rule! Flame Successor Akkan has recommended that you become one of the successors of the sacred flame! Of course, this doesn't mean that you could be king, but at least now you…

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/0-08.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: You now have the opportunity to become a ruler. Flame Successor Akkan has recommended you personally to Flame Lord Kakai! You'll be right at the top with Akkan and Cardia, my friend! Why don't you go try to get a little stronger? (Only a character of level 76 may transfer clas…

Q00078_SagaOfTheDoomcryer/0-02.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: You're actually real? I thought all those stories about you were only legends! You definitely aren't ready for the eternal winter yet. Shield the precious flame in your heart! Listen to your dead souls! (This quest may only be undertaken by a Warcryer of level 76 or above.)

Q00078_SagaOfTheDoomcryer/0-03.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: Tarkai Zu Dudamara! A wandering Warcryer and a seer of webs! He rides on a web, and you can actually trace his path by looking at the webs he leaves behind! He visited me a while back and told me to prepare for the eternal winter. Unless I misunderstood him, you're the one he …

Q00078_SagaOfTheDoomcryer/0-05.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: Everyone is in an uproar about the coming winter! How do you prepare for something that might last forever?! Look at the Humans and the Dwarves! They have nice, thick winter coats and logs in their fireplaces! And meanwhile we, the keepers of the eternal fire, are threatened w…

Now your power will exceed that of the one who can communicate with 99 dead souls! You will communicate with all dead souls at once, and your cries will ring out every place you go! You'll …

Q00078_SagaOfTheDoomcryer/0-08.htm.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: If you can commune with even one dead soul, you will transcend the power of a Warcryer! Now your power will exceed even that of the one who can communicate with 99 dead souls! You'll actually communicate with all dead souls at once, and your cries will ring out every place you…

Q00241_PossessorOfAPreciousSoul1/31336-0.text: Grand Seer Rahorakti: Very well! The item that I require is an ultimate, rare herb that can be collected only once a year! But there is also an easy way to obtain it. Go to the Cemetary located to the east of the Town of Aden, and defeat the Taik Orc Supply Leaders there. If you search their bodies…
Grand Seer Rahorakti: Take this to the dreaming girl now. With Paagrio's blessing she will fulfill her important destiny, harsh as it may be. Keep her safe!
